positive_snippets: Amazing place. Value for the money. The staff is really good and welcoming and always ready to help you. The rooms and bathrooms were clean. No complaints at all about this place can blindly book it for a short stay
negative_snippets: Dont book hotel through Fabhotel site or thorough customer care. Definitely you will loose your money. One more thing in Gurugram don't book hotels via booking.com, agaoda ,etc.,. When you are going to check-in that time only you will realize that they won't consider online bookings..

They wont even guide to the location. I wanted to cancel the reservation as I was not able to reach the location. The customer service is extremely poor they will place your call on hold and no response. I called them 10-15 times with 0 response for my query regarding cancellation. I lost my amount. Extremely worst experience

I had a very disappointing stay at FabHotel Rallkmas. The rooms were not clean – the chair, bedspread, and table were smeared with dirt. The restroom was unhygienic, had a bad smell, and the exhaust fan didn’t work. Overall, the service was very poor and did not meet even basic hospitality standards. I would not recommend this hotel unless they improve their cleanliness and maintenance significantly.
